metaDescription: Ben Stokoe is a front-end focused software engineer building fast, accessible web products.
heroTaglineThree: for teams who care about craft as much as speed.
about:
I'm a software engineer based in the UK, specialising in React, Next.js and TypeScript. I care about performance, accessibility, and building things that are a joy to use.

Outside of client work I like tinkering with side projects, writing about what I learn, and keeping up with the front-end ecosystem.
